acceptance: Republished bundles show no mismatch verdicts; the old ones are replaced or annotated per policy.
context: Source: tuning remediation plan rev2 (2026-10-01; adversarial re-review of develop d39166ea plus independent plan review). Plan Phase 6 (finding A1.12).
description:
## Problem
The published corpus has 5 tuned bundles (DuckDB tpch, ssb, joinorder, clickbench and amplab, all from 2026-08-29), and every one carries false `mismatch` receipts from the index-binding defect. Explorer users see them as unverified.

## Change
After the liveness gate is green, re-run these configurations on the current code and republish through the normal publication workflow. Replace the old bundles, or annotate them as superseded, per publication policy.

## Guardrails (must preserve)
- Follow publication policy; maintainer approval is required.
- Never edit published bundle contents by hand.

## Process guardrails
- One PR per item against `develop`, via the AGENTS.md worktree flow (`make worktree-claim BRANCH=...`, `make agent-write-preflight`).
- Verification ladder: `uv run -- python -m pytest -m fast -q`, `uv run -- ruff check .`, `uv run -- ruff format --check .` and `uv run -- ty check`.
- Then `make pr-preflight` and `make pr-open`.
- Stage explicit paths; never `git add -A`.
- No live cloud runs without explicit user approval stating the command, maximum runtime, log path and stop condition.
- Re-read every file:line anchor before editing. Anchors are from develop d39166ea.
